objective: Fix audit F major D1 (verification/audit-F-2026-11-13.json): context.capture_selection returns ('', True) after the 0.4 s timeout, so a target app that writes the clipboard late leaves the selection in the clipboard and never restores the saved text. Changes: (1) widen the wait to 0.9 s; (2) on timeout return ('', False) and set last_skip_reason='late' (never report restored when nothing was restored); (3) start a background watcher thread that keeps polling GetClipboardSequenceNumber for a 2.0 s grace period after the timeout; when the sequence advances exactly once relative to the post-inject value, it restores the saved CF_UNICODETEXT (or empties if the clipboard was empty) and records last_late_restore=True; if the sequence advances more than once (the user copied something else) it does nothing; the watcher is daemon, never raises, and is cancelled if a new capture starts; (4) desktop.py: when capture returns late/skip, the status line says '選取文字擷取逾時，未取得選取；剪貼簿將在目標回應後自動還原'; (5) scripts/check_context_capture.py: add a delayed-target scenario (a Tk window that writes the clipboard 700 ms after receiving Ctrl+C) and assert the clipboard is restored to the prior text within 3 s and the function returned ('', False); keep the fast scenario; (6) USER_MANUAL.md line ~130: say the clipboard is restored once the target app has answered the copy, normally immediately, and that for very slow apps the selection is not used; STATUS.md 已知限制: replace the wave D clipboard statement accordingly and cite audit-F; (7) D4: STATUS.md:34 and handoffs.md:31 cite the test count 136 from verification/audit-F-2026-11-13.json instead of hotkey-hook JSON. Do not change hotkeys.py.
acceptance: `.\.build-venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes with new tests (timeout returns ('', False) with reason 'late'; watcher restores on single late advance; watcher does nothing on double advance) using an injectable sequence/clipboard stub.
